definitions.explanation: An exam taken for admission to a school, often competitive and determining future educational opportunities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入試|にゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a university entrance exam next month.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying for the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧！

notes:
{入試|にゅうし} is an abbreviation of ⟦{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}→入学試験：09258_nyuugakushiken⟧.

TYPES OF {入試|にゅうし}:
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{入試|にゅうし} (general entrance exam)
- ⟦{推薦|すいせん}→推薦：03358_suisen⟧{入試|にゅうし} (recommendation-based admission)
- AO{入試|にゅうし} (Admissions Office exam - holistic review)
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (Common Test - national standardized test)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入試|にゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to take an entrance exam)
- {入試|にゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧ (to pass)
- {入試|にゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (to fail)
- {入試|にゅうし}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (exam preparation)
- {入試|にゅうし}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (exam questions)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{入試|にゅうし} is extremely important in Japan, often called ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧ (examination war). Results significantly impact future opportunities, leading to intense preparation.
